{"metadata":{"description":"DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: a read-only ledger for the plugins you already have installed — a capability inventory with file:line evidence, declared-vs-detected reconciliation, cross-profile version drift, and a diff of what changed since the last scan.","id":"gh:1343028017","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-harbor","slug":"ZSeven-W/dsh-harbor","topics":["ai-agents","audit","capabilities","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","governance","plugin","static-analysis","supply-chain","transparency"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: a read-only ledger for the plugins you already have installed — a cap"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"ability inventory with file:line evidence, declared-vs-detected reconciliation, cross-profile versio"},{"id":"p1s3","text":"n drift, and a diff of what changed since the last scan."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"DSH Harbor"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"Evidence-first governance for the DeepSeek Harness plugins already installed on your machine."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Capability Inventory • Declared vs Detected • Runtime Attribution • Conflict Detection • Version Dri"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"ft • Change Timeline • Upgrade Preflight"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"npm: @zseven-w/dsh-harbor · Current plugin release: 0.1.0-rc.3 · Tested with DSH 0.1.5-rc.2"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Français · Español · Deutsch · Português · Русский · हिन्दी · Tü"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"rkçe · ไทย · Tiếng Việt · Bahasa Indonesia"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"The Harbor settings page in DSH light mode — live runtime registries, profile-scoped attribution, lo"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"cal version truth, and the change baseline."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Why DSH Harbor"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"DSH plugins run in the host's Node realm with the same local permissions as DSH itself. Harbor does "},{"id":"p9s2","text":"not pretend this can be solved with a score or a badge: it keeps a read-only, evidence-backed ledger"},{"id":"p9s3","text":" of what is installed, what each plugin declares, what its code and live host actually expose, where"},{"id":"p9s4","text":" plugins collide, and what changed since the previous scan."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"### 🔎 Capability Inventory"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Harbor scans every installed third-party bundle across DSH profiles and reports a fixed 13-capabilit"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"y vocabulary. Source findings carry `file:line` evidence; manifest, filesystem, and runtime facts st"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"ate their origin explicitly."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"### 🤝 Declared vs Detected"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Plugins may declare `dsh.capabilities` in `package.json`. Harbor reconciles the declaration against "},{"id":"p13s2","text":"detection, exposes missing and unknown ids, and fails closed on malformed declarations instead of le"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"tting one bad package break the whole report."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"### 🟢 Runtime Attribution"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Inside a live DSH host, Harbor enumerates tools, providers, and routes, then attributes them only to"},{"id":"p15s2","text":" plugins installed in the active profile. Missing host registries remain visible as coverage gaps ra"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"ther than empty proof."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"### ⚠️ Conflict Detection"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"The ledger finds same-profile tool names, route prefixes, provider ids, client-module ids, and order"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"-sensitive message hooks. A quoted route used by a client does not make that client the route owner."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"### 🧭 Two Version Axes"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Cross-profile drift is local and always offline. The optional upstream check is separate, explicit, "},{"id":"p19s2","text":"registry-aware, credential-redacted, and cached for six hours. `link:` and `file:` installs never ma"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"squerade as current registry versions."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"### 🕰️ Change Timeline"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Snapshots track additions, removals, version transitions, profile moves, capability changes, and cla"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"im changes. Even two artifacts exchanging profiles are reported as concrete per-profile transitions."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"### 🛫 Upgrade Preflight"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Before you move DSH to a new version, Harbor installs that exact version into its own cache, then im"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"port-probes every installed plugin against it in a child process, checks `dsh.client.inject` ids aga"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"inst the target's client module graph, and checks host peer ranges. The answer is per profile: boots"},{"id":"p23s4","text":" after the upgrade, or blocked — by which plugin, with the real link-time error."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"### 🧷 One Settings Check"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"The only user-settings check with a known upgrade casualty: when a built-in agent preset is renamed "},{"id":"p25s2","text":"(`code` → `ptc` in DSH 0.1.2) the stored `agent-presets.default` is not migrated and every new sessi"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"on fails. Preflight reports the stale value against the target's preset list."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"The CLI and the settings page consume the same scan core. The target is resolved (a dist-tag needs one registry request) and `@deepseek-ai/dsh@<version>` i"},{"id":"p32s2","text":"s installed into `<state dir>/hosts/<version>` with `npm install -g --prefix`. A completed install i"},{"id":"p32s3","text":"s reused; the global npm prefix and your profiles are never written.
2. Every installed third-party "},{"id":"p32s4","text":"plugin's server entry is imported in a fresh `node` child. Host peer ranges are matched with npm's prerelease rule.
4. `agent-presets.defau"},{"id":"p32s11","text":"lt` from `settings.yaml` is checked against the target's built-in presets."},{"id":"p33s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"### Contract diff between two DSH versions"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"### GitHub Action"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"Plugin authors can run the same preflight on every pull request and every night against the `next` d"},{"id":"p38s2","text":"uthors can run the same preflight on every pull request and every night against the `next` dist-tag:"},{"id":"p39s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p40s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p41s1","text":"### Ecosystem board and release watch"},{"id":"p42s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p43s1","text":"## Capability vocabulary"},{"id":"p44s1","text":"| Surface | Capability ids |"},{"id":"p45s1","text":"| UI and host routes | `client-injection`, `web-routes` |
